parameters.query:
SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name
FROM quotes q
JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id AND c.business_id = q.business_id
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = q.business_id
WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL
  AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.business_id = q.business_id
    AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND (m.direction = 'in' OR (m.sender_type = 'staff' AND (m.metadata->>'automated' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR COALESCE(m.metadata->>'delivery_status', 'sent') = 'sent'))))
LIMIT 10;

SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name
FROM quotes q
JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id AND c.business_id = q.business_id
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = q.business_id
WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL
  AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days 1 hour'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.business_id = q.business_id
    AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND (m.direction = 'in' OR (m.sender_type = 'staff' AND m.metadata->>'follow_up_type' = '3day' AND COALESCE(m.metadata->>'delivery_status', 'sent') = 'sent')))
LIMIT 10;

SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name
FROM quotes q
JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id AND c.business_id = q.business_id
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = q.business_id
WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND (q.valid_until IS NULL OR q.valid_until > NOW())
  AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '72 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.business_id = q.business_id
    AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND (m.direction = 'in' OR (m.sender_type = 'staff' AND m.metadata->>'follow_up_type' = '48h' AND COALESCE(m.metadata->>'delivery_status', 'sent') = 'sent')))
LIMIT 10;

SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name
FROM quotes q
JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id AND c.business_id = q.business_id
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = q.business_id
WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL
  AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days 1 hour'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.business_id = q.business_id
    AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND (m.direction = 'in' OR (m.sender_type = 'staff' AND m.metadata->>'follow_up_type' = '7day' AND COALESCE(m.metadata->>'delivery_status', 'sent') = 'sent')))
LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO messages (business_id, conversation_id, direction, sender_type, message_type, text_body, metadata, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'outgoing', 'staff', 'text', $3, $4::jsonb, NOW(), NOW()) RETURNING id, business_id, conversation_id, text_body, metadata;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata, business_id) VALUES ('quote', $1::uuid, 'automated_follow_up', NULL, 'automation', $2, jsonb_build_object('follow_up_type', $3), jsonb_build_object('quote_number', $4, 'contact_id', $5::uuid, 'timestamp', NOW()), $6::uuid) RETURNING id;
UPDATE messages SET metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('delivery_status', 'sent', 'delivered_at', NOW()) WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, business_id, metadata;
